import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="agency_analyzer.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Refactor to be self-contained"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_91",
    metadata={"eval_id": 219}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
